- The condition for setting the `MOUNT_PROC_JUST_MOUNTED` flag has been modified.

- The line that sets `MOUNT(u)->from_proc_self_mountinfo` to true has been moved outside of the conditional block, ensuring it is always set to true regardless of the flag conditions.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug introduced in a previous commit (ec88d1ea0591) that caused the `MOUNT_PROC_JUST_MOUNTED` flag to be dropped from units. By adjusting the conditions under which this flag is set, the patch ensures that the flag is preserved correctly, thus fixing the bug referenced in issue #11362. The changes enhance the logic for managing mount flags, ensuring that the state of the unit is accurately reflected.

if (!MOUNT(u)->from_proc_self_mountinfo || FLAGS_SET(MOUNT(u)->proc_flags, MOUNT_PROC_JUST_MOUNTED))
